_help: Your favourite models. 'model' is provider/model as the router knows it. 'aliases' are words you can say: 'Jarvis, switch to <alias>'. 'group' picks the colour family on the HUD. Local Ollama models you download are added automatically. 'lina_writer' is the model that turns your spoken rules into Lina (the Lina checker always has the final word). 'personality' is Jarvis's default style: 'grok' (witty, blunt, no lectures) or 'classic'; switch by voice with "Grok mode" / "serious mode". 'jobs' tells the Auto Router what a model is good at: quick, chat, code, reason, long, creative.

daily_limits._help: free requests a day per provider; the Auto Router stops using a provider before it runs out. OpenRouter: 50 (1000 after a one-time $10 credit).

tts._help: free natural voices through OpenRouter (Fish Audio). Each spoken reply uses one OpenRouter request.
tts.jarvis: Speak as Jarvis: a calm, witty, confident British man in his thirties, warm low voice, natural pace.
tts.sophia: Speak as Sophia: a warm, playful, confident young woman, bright expressive voice, natural pace, a little teasing.

elevenlabs._help: Mark's own voices designed in ElevenLabs. Used when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set (Keys form). Costs ElevenLabs credits.
